ventral_fluke_pixel_intensity_distributi.global_contrast_ratio: High-contrast distribution; approximately 70% of pixels in the ventral fluke area are high-intensity (white/off-white) and 30% are low-intensity (black/dark-grey) concentrated at the peduncle insertion and margins.
ventral_fluke_pixel_intensity_distributi.spatial_color_mapping: Large central low-intensity pixel cluster extending from the base upward in a bifurcated pattern. Continuous dark boundary along the trailing edge. Left lobe contains dense vertical and diagonal dark linear streaks. Right lobe features a predominantly white pixel field with two isolated diagonal dark linear markings.

trailing_edge_2d_geometric_contour.median_notch_angle: Acute V-shaped depression at the fluke center with an approximate pixel-based angle of 80-85 degrees.
trailing_edge_2d_geometric_contour.edge_topography_serration_map: High-frequency irregular sawtooth serrations with varying amplitudes (2-10 pixels) across the entire trailing edge; serration amplitude increases towards the lateral tips.
trailing_edge_2d_geometric_contour.lobe_sweep_trajectory: Primary trajectory is convex from the median notch to the mid-point of each lobe, tapering to sharp lateral tips with a slightly concave leading edge profile.

localized_surface_anomalies.rosette_scar_constellations: Clusters of high-intensity, roughly circular pixel groups (barnacle rosettes) localized on the outer distal margins of both lobes.
localized_surface_anomalies.linear_abrasions: Distinct dark linear pixel disruptions visible primarily on the left lobe (vertical orientation) and a single prominent diagonal line on the right lobe.

acquired_anomalies_or_scars: Barnacle colonization visible as white clusters on the trailing edge tips.
